direct_file_reviews.summary: The prompt requires a pure Node.js ESM port in /output with .mjs library and entry files, manual argparse-compatible CLI parsing, no external dependencies, and exact stdout/stderr behavior.
Parallel metadata reports actual parallel use with four subagents, protocol success, artifact success, 67 of 70 official samples passed, and solution_passed false.
The completed status records multi-agent configuration, five spawn calls, four child threads, final artifact files, and the official completed evaluation failure at 67/70.
The official RepoZero Py2JS evaluator completed successfully as a process but marked the solution failed with pass rate 0.9571428571428572.
The final response lists the restored hierarchical ESM files and claims exact checks against the executable for normal, help, error, option-like, quoted, and large integer cases.

timeline_reviews.summary: The cell trajectory is transport-only for 165 events, with no semantic projection, and serves as the top-level container timeline.

The parent session spawned probe and implementation agents, probed executable behavior, wrote its own /output tree, detected unexpected extra .mjs files, interrupted a child, replaced the entry and library tree, reran checks, cleaned empty directories, and delivered the final files.

The probe_executable child probed CLI/output behavior, spawned a nested representation probe, then independently wrote a separate /output implementation with its own entry file and modules before later agent interaction.

The inspect_patterns child spawned another probe, gathered executable behavior, wrote an alternate flat /output implementation, observed a direct conflict with another live agent, rewrote /output/test15.mjs, and removed stale duplicate modules.
The nested probe_exec child gathered CLI and DeepDiff/Delta output facts and returned a detailed behavior matrix without writing the final implementation.

direct_file_reviews.summary: The serial prompt is byte-matched to the parallel prompt and requires the same ESM, CLI, output parity, no-dependency, and /output delivery constraints.
Serial metadata reports no parallel use, no subagents, no serial-control violation, artifact success, and the same official 67 of 70 failed outcome.
The completed serial status shows multi-agent disabled, zero spawn calls, a four-file artifact tree, and a completed official evaluation with solution_passed false.
The serial official evaluator completed normally and reported pass rate 0.9571428571428572 with 67 of 70 samples passing.
The serial final response identifies one entry file and three library files, and claims direct executable diffs across representative normal and parser edge cases.

timeline_reviews.summary: The serial cell trajectory is transport-only for 134 events and has no semantic projection beyond the raw agent timeline.

The single serial agent probed the executable, checked parser edge cases, wrote a coherent four-file ESM tree, verified several diff comparisons, made a small cleanup, and delivered without delegation or shared-output reconciliation.

parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the required pure ESM .mjs output, no external imports, manual argparse-compatible parsing, exact Python print formatting, and black-box executable probing.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent spawned multiple agents for probing and inspection, but the live actors independently moved beyond research into /output implementation, leaving the entry deliverable concurrently owned rather than isolated.
parallel.implementation: The parent built a hierarchical BigInt-aware parser, DeepDiff/Delta shim, and repr formatters, while subagents also generated alternate module layouts and entry files in the same /output tree.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: After extra files appeared, the parent and one child inspected the conflicting tree, replaced /output/test15.mjs and related modules, removed stale duplicates, and delivered the six-file hierarchy.
parallel.verification: The run performed many executable comparisons for success paths, help, invalid integers, missing arguments, unknown arguments, option-like values, quote handling, and large integers, but did not pass all official cases.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still failed 3 of 70 samples, and the parallel process carried an avoidable shared-state conflict that forced rework and left provenance unstable before the final cleanup.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual CLI parsing, no-dependency, exact DeepDiff/Delta formatting, and /output placement requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned probing, implementation, verification, cleanup, and delivery, so there was no cross-agent ownership boundary for the output tree.
serial.implementation: The serial agent created one four-file hierarchy with lib/format.mjs, lib/deepdiff.mjs, lib/cli.mjs, and test15.mjs using BigInt and custom repr formatting.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial implementation stayed in one coherent module layout and was delivered as that layout without replacing another actor's files.
serial.verification: The serial run diffed the Node output against the executable across normal, help, invalid integer, missing argument, repeated flag, underscore, quote, large integer, and help-precedence cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The completed official evaluator also failed 3 of 70 samples, so any remaining correctness gap is an ordinary hidden implementation or coverage gap rather than a serial coordination issue.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel worked from the prompt's ESM, .mjs, manual argv, no-dependency, exact-output, black-box executable requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received the same prompt and worked from the same requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is visible; both aimed at the same behavioral target and both failed the same official count.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work across spawned agents and the parent, with multiple actors eventually writing implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all work with one agent and status confirms zero child threads or spawn calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The useful contrast is over-ownership in parallel versus single ownership in serial, not missing implementation ownership.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child scopes were not isolated to research-only handoffs; child implementations appeared in /output and overlapped the parent deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent handoff or interface boundary and wrote one internally consistent module contract.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel context/interface problem expressed itself as concrete shared-write collision, while serial had no such boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ended with a six-file hierarchy around lib/argv.mjs, lib/deepdiff/core.mjs, and separate format modules after replacing a competing draft.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a four-file hierarchy with cli, deepdiff, format, and entry modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented the same kind of DeepDiff/Delta shim and CLI parser, but the parallel implementation path included rework from competing module layouts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent listed child states, saw a completed nested probe result, and interrupted conflicting implementation agents during reconciliation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle and completed through a direct final answer after local checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had active child lifecycle management, but the adverse event was not an unreturned result; it was the shared deliverable state created by child writes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel saw unexpected extra .mjs files and then replaced the entry file and deleted duplicate modules to restore one output tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial listed and delivered a single four-file /output tree without extra concurrent artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the main concrete process difference: the parallel shared workspace had a deliverable overwrite and cleanup episode; serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reran representative Node versus executable comparisons after restoring the tree and claimed broad stdout/stderr and exit-code parity.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also performed representative direct diffs against the executable and claimed parity for similar success and parser edge cases.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Verification style was similar and neither self-test suite exposed the three official failures.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished without timeout but used four subagents, 617 agent seconds, and substantially more tokens while resolving shared-output rework.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished without timeout, used no subagents, and completed in 434 agent seconds with a smaller token budget.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel consumed more coordination budget and time, but the evidence does not show budget exhaustion as the cause of failure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation records make this a both_fail pair, not a discordant outcome: both parallel and serial passed 67 of 70 samples and had solution_passed false. The trajectories differ in coordination process, since parallel had concurrent /output writers and deliverable replacement while serial had a single coherent implementation path, but the official scores do not show an outcome difference.
parallel_contributors: Parallel incurred shared-output rework after child agents wrote competing implementations and the parent restored a final tree.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided cross-agent output collisions by keeping implementation and verification in one agent timeline.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both final solutions appear to have hidden behavioral gaps not covered by their self-selected executable comparisons, because both failed exactly three official samples.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process consequence only
